name: Orbweb
author: E. T. Carter
description: A frontal orb-weaver web strung across the dark: radial spokes fan from an off-centre hub out to the frame edges, and between them the capture thread winds outward in straight sag-chords that spiral slowly rather than closing into plain rings. Dew beads catch the light and slide along the strands while a soft breeze sways the whole web. The wedges between threads are left open - it reads as wire, never filled cells.

params.label: Spokes
params.effect: How many radial spokes fan out from the hub; few gives a stark star, many a finely divided web.

params.label: Capture pitch
params.effect: Radial spacing of the capture thread in CSS px; small packs many tight rings, large leaves a few wide loops.

params.label: Spiral
params.effect: How far the capture thread winds as it goes out; 0 closes it into concentric chords, high spins it into an open spiral.

params.label: Breeze
params.effect: Amplitude and speed of the breeze that sways and slowly rotates the web; 0 holds it dead still.

params.label: Thread weight
params.effect: Half-width of every strand in CSS px; thin reads as fine silk, thick as soft glowing cord.

params.label: Dew glint
params.effect: Travel speed of the dew beads sliding the threads; 0 rests them as fixed droplets, high sends light coursing along the silk.

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: How far the palette ranges across the web; low washes it one colour, high cycles hues spoke to spoke and ring to ring.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer tugs the hub toward the cursor; 0 ignores the mouse entirely.
